articles.title: Rupee nudges higher, forward premiums dip with focus on US midterm, oil moves
articles.content: On Tuesday, the Indian rupee gained slightly against the dollar, closing at 94.74 per dollar. This change occurred as investors awaited the results of the US midterm elections and developments in the Iran war. Oil prices rebounded, raising concerns about potential impacts on energy supplies. Analysts suggest that potential outcomes from the elections could influence the dollar's short-term position.

articles.title: Bonus issue alert! Choice International to reward shareholders with 1:1 bonus shares. Check details
articles.content: Choice International has approved a 1:1 bonus issue, its first such corporate action in two years. Under the proposal, shareholders will receive one bonus share for every share held on the record date, which will be announced later. The move will double the number of outstanding shares without changing the company’s market capitalisation, while potentially improving stock liquidity and affordability.

articles.title: US Treasury projects $618 billion borrowing in Q4, $800 billion in Q1 2027

Market watchers are eager for upcoming announcements regarding Treasury auctions, as these might indicate changes in their bond issuance tactics.
